Create one production concept image for the Career World skill building "MCP". This is a compact supporting skill structure: highly detailed and distinctive, smaller than project landmarks and much smaller than city capitals. Research-grounded domain summary: A client-server protocol for structured context exchange in which a host maintains dedicated clients to servers, negotiates capabilities and lifecycle, and exchanges tools, resources, prompts, requests, responses, and notifications over defined transports. Accepted baseline identity: A square protocol exchange tower with four unequal orthogonal docking bays, a recessed central roof court, and one diagonal maintenance stair.

Exploration 1 — Canonical Instrument: refine the accepted baseline into a precise compact technical instrument building. Specifically emphasize this researched quality: host client server separation. Do not draw AI agents, chat UI, plug icons, logos, JSON-RPC text, or network diagrams. Keep the protocol exchange architectural and physically joined.

One isolated complete asset in exact orthographic 2.5D isometric perspective, viewed from above at a consistent three-quarter angle. Grayscale only: neutral black, white, and gray with no color tint. Dark near-black technical drafting background with a faint isometric grid. Restrained architectural wireframe line art, matte low-value faces, crisp traced edges, fine parallel construction lines, controlled dense detail, no glow. One image only: no second panel, thumbnails, inset, silhouette swatch, contact sheet, before/after, or detached props. Center the whole coherent structure with generous margin. All roofs, stairs, bridges, annexes, and masses must be buildable and physically connected. No words, letters, numbers, signage, logos, brand marks, UI, charts, arrows, people, vehicles, landscapes, photorealism, fantasy, or real-world facility resemblance.
